scenario_status: historical reference assumptions, not measured destination shares

schema_notes.expected_trip_events: Mean expected stop-arrival boarding-demand weights, not actual boardings or congestion.
schema_notes.conditional_trip_events: All enrollment events select this destination and move immediately; no scenario probabilities applied.
schema_notes.boarding_stage: 1 = initial boarding stop arrival; 2 = transfer stop arrival.
schema_notes.direction: Preserved provider route-direction label; not a standardized compass direction.
schema_notes.time_window: 680 <= bin_minute < 1390; conditional bins additionally retain outside-window events.
schema_notes.replicate_peaks: Maximum within each independent replication; differs from peak of mean bins.
schema_notes.mode_checks: Whole modeled day including arrivals before collection window; first-boarding link checks include all times.

assumptions.source: Unmodified preserved 2026-11-06 engine and archived route/walking data.
assumptions.historical_vector: 55.7/99.9, 27.2/99.9, 17.0/99.9. Historical Sillim represented by Daehak point.
assumptions.dorm_residence: User-selected scenario; current Gwanak actual residence rate remains unknown.
